descriptions.platform_admin: Full system access across all organizations. Can manage platform settings, users, and all organizational data.
descriptions.user: Standard platform user with organization-specific permissions.
descriptions.owner: Full control over the organization. Can manage all settings, members, facilities, bookings, and billing.
descriptions.admin: Administrative access to the organization. Can manage members, facilities, bookings, and most settings.
descriptions.case_handler: Main operational role for handling bookings, customer requests, and operational tasks. Can approve/reject bookings and manage availability.
descriptions.editor: Content management role. Can edit facility descriptions, upload images, manage tags and categories. Cannot handle bookings or manage users.
descriptions.read_only: View-only access to facilities, bookings, and reports. Cannot make any modifications.
descriptions.customer: Standard customer access. Can view facilities, create bookings, and manage own profile.
descriptions.staff_deprecated: DEPRECATED - This role has been replaced by case_handler. Existing staff users will be migrated automatically.
